summary: Silver Point Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 902,356 unregistered common shares at $26.94 per share for aggregate proceeds of $24,309,468, priced through September 21, 2026 subscription agreements under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D or S exemptions. Separately, the board declared a regular monthly dividend of $0.1575 per share payable on or before October 30, 2026. A previously expired August 31, 2026 tender offer settled via non-interest bearing promissory notes, with repurchasing shareholders retaining dividend rights until the September 30 valuation date. This is routine capital-raising and distribution activity, not a special situation.
